name: CapitaLand Ascendas REIT
research_rationale: Buy screen is not confirmed: still no filing bodies, unverified TTM cash flow, and thin 3Q headlines; FY2025 Yahoo operating cash exceeds dividends but leverage and unit dilution persist.

weekly_updates.summary:
Mid–late Nov syndicated 3Q 2026 portfolio-highlight headlines; supplied snippets contain no operating or DPU figures.
Filings index still lists zero SGX bodies; Yahoo quarterly cash flow empty, so screen TTM cash flow remains unverified.
Refreshed Yahoo FY2025 OCF/FCF ~US$1.07bn exceeds ~US$669m cash dividends, but unit base and net debt are up versus 2024.
